Its externalDependsOn rows are on theme branches that have not merged to main: commodities-and-reason (EUDPA-693), arrival-and-transit (EUDPA-694), overview-and-review (EUDPA-696), documents (EUDPA-724) and type-question-and-templates (NO_JIRA). rows.evidence: Live half met on main. The live search goes to reference-data /commodities (frontend origin/main:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/services/commodities/search.js:15-16, client.js:6-15). Reference-data asks MDM which result codes are germinal and drops them (referencedata origin/main:src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/trade/imports/commodities/CommoditySearchService.java:43, :81, :103). The stub catalogue is now a fixture captured from MDM (frontend origin/main:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/services/commodities/stub.js:1-3), and it holds only chapter 01 codes, with no 0511 code (frontend origin/main:src/server/app/services/_capture/fixtures/commodities.json, codes 0101 to 01064900). So criteria 5 and 7 (no semen/embryos/ova/05111000/05119985 results on a live notification) are met. Criterion 8 is met in substance: live commodities are still found and saved. But it names 'Cow, Horse, Cat, Dog and Fish', and the stub has no fish (ostriches stand in for it, per c3183a8e). Germinal half unmet (criteria 1 to 4 and 6): there is no germinal set on main or on any branch. The '12 germinal lines today's live-animals catalogue holds', which criteria 2 to 4 copy, were deleted from the frontend with the hard-coded catalogue (stub.js and matching.js were replaced in c3183a8e). Lines now store commodityCode, speciesLatinName and speciesCommonName, with no commodity name or product type.
rows.proposedChange: Drop criteria 5 and 7 (met on main), and keep one regression check that a live search for 'semen' or 05119985 lists nothing. Restate criterion 8 as 'live commodities found through the MDM search (for example cattle 0102, horses 0101, cats under 01061900) can still be chosen and saved'. Rewrite criteria 1 to 4 and 6. The germinal page searches germinal commodities only, through reference-data: add a germinal-only search beside /commodities, keeping the isGerminal codes the live search drops, plus a stub fixture captured from it. Add referencedata to repos. Keep the germinal search hint and the page copy (criterion 1), search through the Search button (criterion 3), 'cattle finds only cattle germinal lines' (criterion 4) and 'save and reopen keeps the selection' (criterion 6). Replace criterion 2's fixed 12-line list with 'the germinal commodities MDM lists under 05111000 and 05119985, each with its species and product type'. Call I made: the 9 Oct afternoon ruling kept the germinal catalogue on 'today's data' only because MDM was not live. Now that it is, the hard-coded 12 lines are gone, so the rewrite reads MDM's germinal list rather than rebuilding a hand-made one. V4's 18-item shape and separate embryos and ova stay in blocked inc-191. Sam may prefer a germinal-set stub of the old 12 lines instead.

rows.proposedChange: Criterion 4: 'A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row per code listing all its chosen species, laid out as the live page lays it out (code, then species), and its block heading shows the code and the germinal product type'. The product type must be stored on the line, because MDM's code 05119985 covers several product types. Criterion 7: 'each germinal trade line carries SEMEN for a semen line and EMBRYO for any embryos or ova line, until inc-191 separates them', derived from the stored product type. Keep criteria 1 to 3, 5, 6 and 8 to 12 as they are. Name the stored line fields commodityCode, speciesLatinName and speciesCommonName, matching main.
